scores.reasons: Gap is large: unclaimed profile, no phone on it, placeholder website, no intake at all. Ability to pay is limited - owner-operator doing painting and small remodels. Ease is the highest in the batch: claiming the profile and adding a phone number is nearly free. Evidence is good: I saw the unclaimed profile, the placeholder site and the review content.

caveats: Google review counts were usually not rendered in the Maps panel I could open without signing in, so counts come from the businesses' own review widgets or from directory mirrors and may be out of date.

Every page title I read through the browser carried a leading emoji character that also appeared on an unrelated error page; I treated it as an artefact of the test browser, not a site defect, and did not score it.
Arias Floor Coverings and A&J Kitchen and Bath could not be confirmed as trading; both are kept in the batch for completeness but should not be assigned to a deep audit without a phone check.
Angi, HomeAdvisor and BuildZoom returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so review details from those sources come from search snippets rather than pages I opened.
data_gaps: No confirmed Google review counts for Lincoln Roofing, Stearn Brothers, A.W. Hobor, Molnar Roofing or Erazo; the Maps panel showed ratings only.

Arias Floor Coverings: no phone number in the batch data, no resolving website, no Google profile under that name; the closest match 'Arias Floors Enterprise' is permanently closed but has a different name and phone, so closure is unconfirmed.

A&J Kitchen and Bath: cannot verify trading. Its only live page is a Ferma retailer directory entry; 1777 US-130 has no Google listing for a kitchen/bath business, and the listed phone matches Klassic Kitchen & Bath at 1626 US-130, whose own domain does not resolve.
Molnar Roofing's domain molnarroofinginc.com now redirects to an unrelated 'Access Denied' page, so no site content could be reviewed.
Could not test any booking flows end to end: no business in this batch offered online scheduling, and I did not submit any forms.
No pricing, staff headcount or revenue figures are published by any business in this batch; size judgements are inferences from licences, years in business, review volume and site depth.
